exposure: Fetal head position (occiput posterior vs. non-occiput posterior)
outcome: Duration of remaining time in labor
cohort: 142 nulliparous women with a singleton cephalic presentation at term and prolonged labor at Stavanger University Hospital, Norway, and Addenbrooke's Hospital, Cambridge, UK
finding: Occiput posterior (OP) fetal head position assessed by transabdominal ultrasound was significantly associated with delivery by Cesarean section in nulliparous women with prolonged labor.
